**Zero:** If + Present Simple, **Present Simple** — *If you **press** this, it **stops**.*
**First:** If + Present Simple, **will** + V — *If it **rains**, we**'ll stay** in.*

- In the main part of type 1, instead of *will* you can use *can, may, might, should* or an order: *If you see Tom, **tell** him to call me.*
- After *if, unless, when, as soon as, until, provided (that)* — **no will**: *If I **see** him…* (not ~~if I will see~~)
- **unless** = if … not: *Unless you hurry… = If you don't hurry…*
- The parts can swap places: *We'll stay in if it rains.*
Type 1: If + Present Simple, will + V.
1 тип: результат у майбутньому — will +: Type 1: the result is in the future — will + V.
If she calls, I ___ (tell) her you're bu: If she calls, I ___ (tell) her you're busy. (2 words)
unless уже означає «якщо не» — друге зап: unless already means “if not” — a second negative is extra.
will стоїть у головній частині, а не піс: will goes in the main part, not after if.
Закони природи, як працює техніка: if =: Laws of nature, how machines work: if = “every time that”.
When I see Mykola, I'll tell him.
Кома ставиться, коли *if*-частина стоїть: Use a comma when the *if*-part comes first: *If it rains, …* but *We'll stay at home if it rains.*
A particular situation in the future.
Майбутнє, яке цілком може статися, — пер: A future that may well happen — the first conditional.
Ми запізнимося на потяг, якщо не вийдемо: We'll miss the train unless we leave now.
We're not sure we'll see him.
Попередження → 1 тип: If you eat…, you'l: A warning → type 1: If you eat…, you'll feel sick.
Порада чи інструкція з умовою: Advice or an instruction with a condition
Після if — Present Simple навіть про май: After if — Present Simple even about the future: don't hurry.
Після if — Present Simple, навіть про ма: After if — Present Simple, even about the future.
Після when про майбутнє — теж Present Si: After when about the future — Present Simple too.
Реальний план з умовою: A real plan with a condition
Real: the interview has already happened.
The result is in the future — will.
It always happens like this — a general rule.
We'll definitely see him — the only question is when.
In the main part — an order or should.
Умовне речення пов'язує умову й наслідок: A conditional sentence links a condition and a result: “if one thing — then another”. The zero conditional is about what is always true: facts, rules, habits. The first is about a real possibility in the future: the condition may well come true, and we say what will happen then.
An imagined situation — the second conditional.
What will happen if you do (or don't do) something: will, won't.
Що зазвичай відбувається за цієї умови —: What usually happens under this condition — also the zero conditional.
Якби я отримав роботу в Нью-Йорку, то пе: Imagine I got a job in New York — I'd move there.
In case it's cold, I'll put on a jacket.
In case you're hungry, there's borscht in the fridge.
Якщо завтра буде гарна погода, ми влашту: With nice weather tomorrow, we'll have a picnic by the Dnipro.
Якщо змішати синій і жовтий, вийде зелен: Blue and yellow mixed together make green.
With some free time, I'll phone you in the evening.
Якщо нагріти воду до 100 градусів, вона: Water heated to 100 degrees starts to boil.
With no rain, we'll have a barbecue.
Without a coat, you'll be cold.
In case I see Mykola, I'll tell him.
I'll open the window, if that's OK with you.
Every time I'm late, my boss gets angry.
Якщо я отримаю цю роботу, то переїду до: With this job, I'll move to London.
Якщо я п'ю каву після шостої, то не можу: Every time I drink coffee after six, I can't fall asleep.
Якщо я сьогодні запізнюся, начальник роз: Being late today will make my boss angry.
